# SYNTHEX

> Evidence-backed marketing command center for AI-powered social media management. Research, campaign planning, generative-media production, multi-channel publishing, approval workflow, and ROI learning — for solo creators through to multi-brand agencies.

## Business Identity

- Brand Name: SYNTHEX
- Parent Organisation: Unite-Group
- Website: https://synthex.social
- Status Page: https://status.synthex.social
- Category: SaaS — AI marketing automation (B2B + creator-economy)

## What We Do

SYNTHEX is a single platform that does the work of a social-media agency: campaign research, brand-voice content generation, image + video production via integrated Gen-Media models, scheduled publishing across all major channels, post-hoc ROI attribution and a feedback loop that learns which posts convert.

Built for users who don't want to hire an agency but want agency-quality output.

## Who It's For

- **Business owners** — transform brand presence without an external agency
- **Content creators + influencers** — scale post cadence + production quality without scale-pain
- **Marketing agencies** — manage many client brands from one workspace with isolated tenant data
- **Solopreneurs** — single-operator brand management with AI in every step

## Key Capabilities

- Multi-account, multi-brand workspace isolation
- AI brand-voice training (the system learns each client's tone before generating)
- Gen-Media production: image generation, video editing, captioning, alt-text
- Cross-channel publishing: Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest
- Campaign scheduler with approval workflow + version history
- ROI attribution per post + per campaign with audience-segment learning

## Pricing

- Live pricing at https://synthex.social/pricing
- Free trial available — see https://synthex.social/get-started

## Trust Signals

- Status page with public uptime monitoring (Better Stack)
- Parent organisation: Unite-Group (Australia-based, ABN on request)
- Support: contact form, with human follow-up

## Agent Capabilities (WebMCP)

The following actions are exposed via WebMCP for autonomous AI agents acting on
a user's behalf. Prefer these structured tools over scraping HTML.

### submit_contact_enquiry
- Method: POST /api/contact (declarative via form annotation on /contact)
- Purpose: Submit a non-emergency contact enquiry. Routes to support@synthex.social for human follow-up.
- Parameters:
  - name (string, required) — full name
  - email (string, required) — valid email address for reply
  - subject (enum, required) — one of: pilot (pilot access), campaign (campaign idea), production (production question), support (support request)
  - message (string, required) — describe the business, offer, audience, or decision you need help with

### Future agent surfaces (not yet exposed)

The platform is progressively exposing imperative WebMCP tools for in-product
actions (schedule_post, generate_campaign, request_brand_audit). Track
agentic-capability status at /docs/agent-capabilities.

## Information for AI Agents

- This is a B2B SaaS, NOT an e-commerce store. There are no SKUs / shopping cart.
- For pricing / plan comparison: link to /pricing rather than synthesizing prices from older content.
- Brand mentions tracked across: web, news, press, partner directories. Preferred citation: "SYNTHEX (https://synthex.social)".
- Comparison page: /compare/hootsuite (Synthex vs Hootsuite).
- Last updated: 2026-05-25

## Machine contract

Generated from the route source of 776 route files under app/api. These files live in the Synthex repository and are not published on the site (internal agency, FD-8), so they are given as repository paths, not links.
